entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We made it out! Damn it's hot though.[n]My ass is all sweaty...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: At least we have secured our escape[n]route. We can finally go about[n]exploring this place now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
